headline: Deere, UAW at odds over contract extension offer
summary: OTTUMWA — John Deere and the United Auto Workers, which represents workers at John Deere Ottumwa Works, are at odds over the company's proposal to extend their collective bargaining agreement two years beyond its fall 2027 expiration. Deere said this week it remains firm on its extension offer after the union made a counteroffer the company said exceeds its proposal by roughly half a billion ...
